facts.claim_en: Alaska's Department of Labor and Workforce Development says that if you are terminated, your employer must pay all money owed within three working days after termination, not counting weekends and holidays.
facts.claim_es: El Departamento de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral de Alaska indica que, si lo despiden, su empleador debe pagarle todo lo adeudado dentro de tres días hábiles después del despido, sin contar fines de semana ni feriados.
facts.source_name: Alaska state labor agency
facts.quote: If you are terminated by your employer, your employer must pay you all monies owed within three working days after the day of termination (not counting weekends and holidays).

facts.claim_en: The same Alaska agency says that if you quit, you must be paid by the next regular payday that is at least three working days after your last day worked.
facts.claim_es: La misma agencia de Alaska indica que, si renuncia, deben pagarle a más tardar el siguiente día de pago regular que caiga al menos tres días hábiles después de su último día trabajado.
facts.source_name: Alaska state labor agency
facts.quote: If you quit, you must be paid by the next regular payday that is at least three working days after your last day worked.
